text: The Lessor shall be entitled to revise the annual rental by 7% for each subsequent tenancy year.
The rental amount for any renewed term shall be determined using the RERA rent calculator applicable on the renewal date.
Rent for the following year will be whatever the Landlord is charging for comparable units in the building at that time.
The Second Party accepts a fixed uplift of AED 8,000 on the yearly rent should he choose to stay another year.
The Landlord will let the Tenant know of any new rent two weeks before the tenancy ends.
Should either side want different conditions for the next term, that side must write to the other no later than 90 days ahead of the end date.
The Lessor can alter the payment schedule and number of cheques for the renewed term without prior notification.
If the Owner wishes to move into the apartment himself, the Tenant must hand it back within two months of being told.
The Lessor may ask the Tenant to leave if the unit is to be demolished, provided twelve months' notice is sent by registered post.
The Tenant shall be evicted immediately if any cheque is returned unpaid.
A purchaser of the unit shall take it subject to this tenancy for the remainder of the term.
Should the Tenant wish to break the lease, he shall forfeit two months' rent.
The Tenant is locked in for the full twelve months and cannot hand back the unit sooner.
If the Second Party moves out before the end date for any reason, the rent already paid will not be returned.
The lease may be ended ahead of time only where both parties consent in writing.
The Second Party shall fix anything that stops working in the flat, at his own expense.
Servicing of the AC units twice a year is for the Lessor's account.
The Owner accepts no responsibility for leaks, pest infestation or appliance failure during the tenancy.
The Lessor shall hold a sum of AED 4,000 as security, to be handed back once the unit is inspected and found in the same state as received, fair usage excepted.
Any repainting required when the Tenant leaves will be charged against the security amount at a flat AED 2,500.
